question: Why quibble over difference if nothing is to accept or reject?
premises: Well then, so be it, even difference; we are no lovers of mere words.
Let it be, for us there is nothing to reject or accept, as with you here.
inference: Difference conceded without word-fondness, with nothing to take or leave on either side.
plain_english: Well then, so be it — even difference; we are no lovers of mere words. Let it be — for us there is nothing to reject or accept, as with you here.
